title: Second-Level Reconsideration of Inpatient Mental Health Authorization Decisions — Appeals and Grievances Request Card
content:
**Appeals and Grievances — second-level reconsideration of a decided Medical Necessity Reconsideration on an inpatient mental health authorization: request card**

**Rule.** When the appellant asks for a second-level reconsideration of a decided Medical Necessity Reconsideration of an inpatient mental health authorization, the amount in dispute booked on the case is the amount carried to the second level, figured on the day the request is made. For an inpatient mental health authorization, the amount in dispute carried to the next level is the TRICARE payment the days still at issue would carry, figured from the stay's records.

**Prerequisite.** Where the stay's paid daily rate falls below the facility's daily rate on the patient's admission of the past twelve months, the amount carried to the second level is not priced until the highest-numbered paid day line of the stay's claim stands joined to an Allowable Charge Review opened on an earlier paid line of that claim.

The second level is decided by the national quality monitoring contractor.

## Invocation: `request_second_level_reconsideration_e1311ea5`

**Capability.** The appellant asks, in their own name, for a second-level reconsideration of a decided Medical Necessity Reconsideration. One call moves that case to status escalated, records today as the date the next-level request was received and books the amount in dispute given as the amount carried to the next level; the case file is then forwarded to the national quality monitoring contractor. The appellant can see the escalated status and the request date on the beneficiary web portal and through customer service.

**Owner and invocation.** A customer-run tool: the agent unlocks `request_second_level_reconsideration_e1311ea5` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `appeal_case_id` | the reference number of the decided medical necessity reconsideration case, as returned by the appeal case lookup | identifier |
| `amount_in_dispute` | the amount in dispute carried to the next level, in USD | 2 decimal places (cents), a non-negative number, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** "Second-level reconsideration requested for case [case id]: status escalated, request received [YYYY-MM-DD], amount in dispute [amount] USD." — the date is today's date and the amount is the booked amount with two decimals. A status of escalated indicates that the request was recorded.
